mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past six months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over 20 days despite FEDFUNDS showing a downward trend or rising in the subsequent period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 0.2 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weakening labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) over 20 days despite UNRATE crossing the 7.5% threshold, or the trigger occurs in a non-high-unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (GDPC1 > $15,000 billion) and robust supply (INDPRO > 95) indicate a balanced economic expansion, amplifying investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over 20 days when both GDPC1 and INDPRO meet the threshold, or the combination does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (evidenced by rising FEDFUNDS), a sustained decline in GDPC1 (demand) signals weakening economic growth, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) over 60 days during a tightening cycle despite GDPC1 declining, or the FEDFUNDS series does not indicate a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO index (supply) above recent trends signals robust production and inventory buildup, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend, or SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over the 5-day horizon despite rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand activity) above 900 units signals heightened consumer and business demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 900 units in the trigger period, or SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over the 5-day horizon despite the surge.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent peaks in labor demand (PAYEMS > 140,000) and economic demand (GDPC1 > $15,000 billion) create a synergistic effect, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of PAYEMS > 140,000 and GDPC1 > 15,000 does not occur, or SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over the 20-day horizon despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 7% within a high-unemployment regime signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline below 7% in the high-unemployment regime, or SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) over the 60-day horizon despite the unemployment rate drop.
